NewsArticle.Title: Teacher's Nobility
NewsArticle.Content:
Teachers now have about 1 in 2 chance of gaining a noble mark when teaching to class of 12 or more students. With very few noble marks one can gain noble titles, noble garments, some of which include Platemail, Claymyth, and Dolman. These garments are normally wearable at the 71st or 97th insight. See Jean in Loures for details on Noble Garments.
Mundanes and Aislings love the classes they have attended and look forward to more classes, especially ones scheduled ahead of time. Speak to the mundanes and Aislings at Mileth College just south of Glioca's shrine to learn more about classes and teaching.
